outcome: qualified rate of follow-up assessment of pediatric heart surgery
cohort: 286 infants with complex congenital heart disease (CHD) (126 diagnosed prenatally and 160 diagnosed postnatally) at Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital from January 2012 to December 2017
finding: Prenatal diagnosis of complex CHD was associated with a lower frequency of treatment termination after birth, lower postoperative complication rates, and improved clinical prognosis compared to postnatal diagnosis.
